THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
195
STUDY 163
Burgundy Leather Jacket & Belted Mini
Rights check
Source: 25057.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight blonde hair
stands on a rooftop terrace with black planters and a
city skyline behind her. She wears a fitted burgundy
leather zip jacket with a high collar and cropped peplum
hem, with a black leather mini skirt and a wide black
belt with an oversized silver buckle. Tall black
pointed-toe knee boots complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Bright, natural daylight.
Palette of oxblood, black, and silver. Bold and sleek, in
the style of a fall street-style editorial.
Bold, sleek, urban
WORKING NOTES
- The oxblood leather and belt buckle are the defining
elements.
- Keep the rooftop planters for a sophisticated urban
frame.
